sources.field_scope: Party and charter vessel license. Applies to vessels carrying recreational passengers to take marine species. Owner filings, decal, $100 resident and $300 nonresident fees, expiration on the last day of December. Latest cited amendment effective 2021-07-06.
Catch and effort reports the director may require. Individual reports may be released outside the department only in a statistical format. This section was not treated as the license-roster rule.
sources.bulk: Statistical release of reports. No license file.

sources.field_scope: Active rule 250-RICR-90-00-2, effective 2026-01-01 to 2027-01-01. Section 2.9 is the party and charter vessel license, SAFIS log, and annual negative report. Section 2.7.8(G) aggregates commercial report data released to the public. A successor amendment is flagged effective 2027-01-01 and was not used.
sources.bulk: Rule text. The page links https://risos-apa-production-public.s3.amazonaws.com/DEM/REG_13380_20251031114142449.pdf. That PDF was not opened as a separate file.
sources.attribution: Official filed regulation. The department disclaimer says the Secretary of State filing controls.
sources.request_process: License filing is to the department. The rule does not post a holder list.

sources.field_scope: Active Port of Galilee berth rule, effective 2025-10-07. Defines charter boats and headboats, berth criteria, fees, and the requirement of a commercial declaration or a party and charter license. No assignment list is in the text.
sources.bulk: Rule text. The page links https://risos-apa-production-public.s3.amazonaws.com/DEM/REG_13371_20250917123151870.pdf. That PDF was not opened as a separate file.
sources.request_process: Berth applications go to the Division of Coastal Resources. The waiting list is internal.
